name: code-spider-vscode
description: Shows the callers and callees of the function under the cursor as a typed graph.

codeSpider.worker.maxHeapMb.description: Maximum heap, in megabytes, of the analysis worker. Raise it if Code Spider reports running out of memory on a very large project. Changing it restarts the worker.

codeSpider.codeLens.enabled.description: Show a ⧉ Graph CodeLens above function, component and class declarations.

keybindings.when: editorTextFocus && (editorLangId == typescript || editorLangId == typescriptreact || editorLangId == javascript || editorLangId == javascriptreact)

editor/context.when: editorLangId == typescript || editorLangId == typescriptreact || editorLangId == javascript || editorLangId == javascriptreact

commandPalette.when: editorLangId == typescript || editorLangId == typescriptreact || editorLangId == javascript || editorLangId == javascriptreact

scripts.test:smoke: pnpm --workspace-root build && node build-smoke.mjs && node dist/smoke/run.cjs
